label: Брать
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for брать (to take).

missions.phrase: Я всегда беру зонт в дорогу.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person singular present. 'Беру' is the 1sg present of imperfective брать, which has the suppletive present stem бер-, very different from the infinitive. 'Зонт' is the accusative object.

missions.phrase: Ты часто берёшь книги в библиотеке?
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Second-person singular present. 'Берёшь' is the 2sg present of брать, built on the бер- stem with the stressed -ёшь ending. 'Книги' is the plural accusative object.

missions.phrase: Он берёт уроки игры на гитаре.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Third-person singular present. 'Берёт' is the 3sg present of брать on the бер- stem with -ёт. 'Брать уроки' is the fixed idiom 'to take lessons'. Note the contrast with берет, a beret.

missions.phrase: Мы берём с собой много еды.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person plural present. 'Берём' is the 1pl present of брать with the stressed -ём on the бер- stem. The phrase 'с собой' marks what we take along with us.
Strategic focus: Third-person plural present. 'Берут' is the 3pl present of брать on the бер- stem with -ут, completing the present ladder. 'Такси' is an indeclinable accusative object.

missions.phrase: Вчера я брал деньги в долг.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine past tense. 'Брал' is the past m. sg. of брать, formed from the infinitive stem бра- plus -л. The imperfective stresses the ongoing or repeated act of borrowing.

missions.phrase: Она брала пример со старшей сестры.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Feminine past tense. 'Брала' is the past f. sg. of брать with -ла. 'Брать пример' is the idiom 'to follow someone's example', here looking up to an older sister.
Strategic focus: Plural past tense. 'Брали' is the past pl. of брать with -ли. The imperfective marks a repeated past action, taking the toys again and again without permission.
Strategic focus: Singular imperative. 'Бери' is the informal command of брать, formed from the present stem бер- plus -и. The perfective partner взять gives the one-time command 'возьми'.

Strategic focus: Infinitive use. 'Брать' is the bare infinitive after the modal 'надо', here negated. The imperfective fits a general prohibition, while perfective взять would point to one specific act.
